gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o2 -> i11: intentionally added
ADDED i2: A distance with no threshold; it always computes the exact edit distance.
ADDED i3: Asserts that a {@link LevenshteinResults} carries exactly the expected distance and the expected breakdown of insert, delete and substitute operations. @param a
ADDED i4: A null input must be rejected even when the other input is a valid (empty) CharSequence.
ADDED i5: Every combination involving a null SimilarityInput must be rejected, regardless of whether the threshold is zero or unset (null).
ADDED i6: With a threshold of 0, any non-zero distance is reported as -1 (threshold exceeded).
ADDED i7: The CharSequence overload and the SimilarityInput overload must agree.
ADDED i8: "hello" -> "hallo": a single substitution.
ADDED i9: The CharSequence overload and the SimilarityInput overload must produce equal results.
ADDED i10: "zzzzzzzz" -> "hippo": 3 deletions and 5 substitutions.
ADDED i12: Two empty inputs: distance of zero with no operations.
ADDED i13: The SimilarityInput overload must produce a result equal to the CharSequence overload.
ADDED i14: Each case checks the unlimited (no-threshold) distance and its insert/delete/substitute breakdown.
ADDED i15: Two empty inputs: no edits required.
ADDED i16: "" -> "a": one insertion.
ADDED i17: "aaapppp" -> "": delete all seven characters.
ADDED i18: "frog" -> "fog": delete the 'r'.
ADDED i19: "fly" -> "ant": substitute every character.
ADDED i20: "elephant" -> "hippo": 3 deletions and 4 substitutions.
ADDED i21: "hippo" -> "elephant": the mirror case, 3 insertions and 4 substitutions.
ADDED i22: "hippo" -> "zzzzzzzz": 3 insertions and 5 substitutions.
ADDED i23: "zzzzzzzz" -> "hippo": the mirror case, 3 deletions and 5 substitutions.
ADDED i24: "hello" -> "hallo": a single substitution.
ADDED i25: Each case applies a threshold-limited distance. When the true distance exceeds the threshold, the algorithm gives up and reports a distance of -1 with all count
ADDED i26: Threshold large enough: the exact result is returned.
ADDED i27: Threshold 6 < distance 7: exceeded.
ADDED i28: Threshold 0 with differing single characters: exceeded.
ADDED i29: Identical inputs: distance 0, within any non-negative threshold.
ADDED i30: "aaa" -> "bbb": three substitutions; only allowed when threshold >= 3.
ADDED i31: Mixed delete + substitute cases within threshold.
ADDED i32: "a" -> "bbb": two insertions and one substitution; allowed when threshold >= 3.
ADDED i33: Thresholds too small for the required edits: all exceeded.
ADDED i34: Length difference alone (2) already exceeds threshold 1.
ADDED i35: Small, within-threshold edits.
ADDED i36: "elephant" <-> "hippo": distance 7, allowed only when threshold >= 7.
ADDED i37: "hippo" <-> "zzzzzzzz": distance 8.
ADDED i38: "hello" -> "hallo": one substitution.
ADDED i39: With Integer.MAX_VALUE the threshold never binds, so results match the unlimited algorithm.
ADDED i40: Results that are logically equal must share a hash code.
ADDED i41: Results that are logically equal must share a string representation.
